stories.title: Gold Glove Sweep Watch — Cubs Could Make History
stories.angle: PCA (CF), Happ (LF, 4 straight GGs), Suzuki (RF, NL leader in FRV) — three Cubs outfielders are Gold Glove contenders. No team has EVER swept all three outfield spots since Gold Gloves went position-by-position in 2011. Bittersweet: this trio may be splitting up this winter.

Could happen this November. Even if it's their last season together.
